status: completed in 0.83.2; public Spectra published and exact 18 superseded repositories removed

mixed.AppHeapDiag: VM reserve/commit/fault/release and HOLDVM move; SDK allocator, cache/trim and HOLD allocator fixture remain.
mixed.StorageDiag: Block queue/performance and VM/backing/pager probes move; controller/device inventory, drive discovery and hardware smoke remain.
mixed.AudioDiag: Audio driver/service checks remain; counters used to validate that operation remain contextual evidence.
mixed.DisplayDiag: Graphics-scene/renderer/display workloads remain. Kernel counters only validate this workload; no separate general kernel view was found.
mixed.SysInfo: General system identity/time/hardware overview remains; detailed kernel memory diagnostics move.
mixed.LogCenter: Non-kernel sources remain; kernel bootlog source moves to Spectra.
mixed.Terminal: Shell/output-sharing checks remain; no DMESG implementation found. SysInfo reference to DMESG is stale.
mixed.NetIoDiag: Kernel TCP performance moves; external TCPSVC/UDPSVC socket lifecycle, completion, worker status and SDK connectivity-name contracts remain.
mixed.SshService: Remove direct kernel task/heap inventory from R4DIAG; retain transport-only PING. SPECTRA METRICS TASKS includes complete task owner/generation identities.

boundary_notes: The existing BLIT workload exercises kernel display/surface_pipeline and kernel presentation accounting; it does not become a GPU-specific benchmark.
FAT and NTFS implementations currently belong to Repositories/Kernel/fs; their existing contract/fixture checks are in scope.
A diagnostic's incidental counter assertions do not constitute a second general kernel measurement UI.
Preserve every required fixture before removing a source repository; adapt recursive child commands and resource/module identity checks.
Deletion follows actual migration and proof, and verifies the exact public repository and its remaining purpose.

NetDiag uses kernel net/core synthetic lifecycle/adapter/backend/protocol-runtime probes. NetSvcDiag RESTART operates the builtin net service IPC handler, not an external R4X proxy. Both therefore migrate; duplicate DRIVERLIFETEST maps to the network driver lifecycle probe.
